_note: Search and sharing text for each public page. Titles stay under about 60 characters and descriptions under 160, so search results show them in full. {pdfs}, {classes}, {cases} and {media} are filled in from the data at build time. The English text is in the page HTML; the Bengali text is used when a reader switches language.
